City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 15, 2018 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
Council Member Muir will be teleconferencing from the following location: 3633 Villa Knolls E Drive, Las Vegas NV 89120
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of SANDAG accomplishments and look ahead by Chair Sinnot
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-08-15 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Design Services Contract for ADA & Green Street Improvements for Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Project. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the City Manager or her designee to execute a contract in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with Rick Engineering in the amount of $239,109 plus 15% contingencies to finalize design of the ADA and Green Street Improvements for Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Project (CS19B), for a total contract amount not to exceed $274,976.
2018-08-15 Item 08B Morning Sun ADA PHASE 2
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance 2018-09 Amending Section 2.48.020 of the Encinitas Municipal Code regarding the Youth Commission to reduce the membership. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
City Council to introduce Ordinance 2018-09 titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Section 2.48.020 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Youth Commission Membershipâ€ effective starting with the FY 2019-20 Youth Commission Term.
2018-08-15 Item 08C Introduction of Ordinance 2018-09 EMC 2.48.020 Youth Commission
8D.
2017 State Homeland Security Grant in the amount of $38,242 for the Purchase of 800 MHz Replacement Radios. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Accept $38,242 in federal funds from a 2017 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) grant awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase of 800 MHz radios; and 2) Authorize the Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit the required California Governor's Office of Emergency Services Fiscal Year 2017 Grant Assurances.
2018-08-15 Item 08D FY17 State Homeland Security Grant Award Acceptance
8E.
Consideration of Resolution 2018-62 Adopting the Amended Records Retention Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve Resolution 2018-62 Adopting the Amended Citywide Records Retention Schedule.
2018-08-15 Item 08E Amending Records Retention Schedule
8F.
Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group for the Standard Pacific Park Site. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute an amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group, for additional design services of the bicycle/skate spot element for the Standard Pacific Park Site.
2018-08-15 Item 08F Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group for the Standard Pacific Park Site
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Wayfinding Signs for Downtown Encinitas. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Authorize the City Manager to direct staff to coordinate with Encinitas 101 Mainstreet Association to review, approve and install wayfinding signs and monuments in downtown Encinitas as presented in Attachment 1 at the approximate location indicated in the map contained in Attachment 2; and 2) Accept the donation of wayfinding signs and monuments from Encinitas 101 Mainstreet Association at a value of $15,000.00.
2018-08-15 Item 10A Wayfinding Signs
10B.
City Council acceptance of and action on the City Clerkâ€™s Certification of Initiative Petition titled â€œAn Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Authorizing Commercial Cannabis Activities Involving Retail Sales, Cultivation, Manufacturing, Cannabis Kitchens and Distribution, and Personal Use Cultivation, Subject To Certain Regulations and Restrictions.â€ Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Adopt the ordinance, without alteration, at the regular meeting at which the certification of the petition is presented, or within 10 days after it is presented; 2) Submit the ordinance, without alteration, to the voters pursuant to Elections Code Section 1405; or 3) Order a report pursuant to Elections Code Section 9212 to be presented to the City Council within the time frame prescribed by the City Council, but no later than 30 days after the elections official certifies the petition to the legislative body. When the report is presented to the legislative body, the legislative body shall either adopt the ordinance within 10 days or submit the ordinance, without alteration, to the voters pursuant to Elections Code 1405.
2018-08-15 Item 10B Certification of Cannabis Initiative
10C.
Housing Element Update, also known as the Housing Plan Update 2018 - review and approval of the City Council Subcommittee's proposed ballot rebuttal argument and approving up to five signatories. Contact Persons: Council Subcommittee of Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Kranz (THERE IS NO AGENDA REPORT - PROPOSED REBUTTAL TO BE PRESENTED AT THE MEETING)
1) Consider City Council Subcommittee's proposed ballot rebuttal argument; 2) Consider public comment; 3) Approve City Council Subcommittee's ballot rebuttal argument and designate the Mayor and City Council Members (up to five total) to sign the ballot rebuttal argument, or as may be modified by the City Council.
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Re-certification of the Sewer System Management Plan (SSMP). Contact Person: Public Works Director Quiram and Superintendent Atherton
Recommend that the Council accept and re-certify the changes to the SSMP and authorize the Public Works Director to sign the amended plan.
2018-08-15 Item 11A Sewer System Management Plan
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2018-08-15 Item 15 City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 22, 2018
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
